description: An expander for the TM Rythm sequencer, adding up a voltage from whichever of the register's top five bits are high; it goes to the right of the sequencer

params.text: Sets the voltage this knob adds while its bit of the sequence is high, which is a fifth of what the knob reads: 0V to 2V from this one, and 10V with all five raised and all five bits high

outputs.text: The sum of the voltages from the knobs whose bits are high, 0V to 10V

notes: the knobs follow the register's top five bits in order down the panel, the topmost knob taking the fifth bit down from the top of the register and the bottom knob taking its top bit
this expander works anywhere down the chain of modules to the right of a TM Rythm; with no sequencer anywhere to its left the output stays at 0V
every knob comes up at zero, so the output is 0V until at least one of them is raised
